name: Yagiza Kapuriru
source:
The Prince of Capricorn: a serious, hard-working klutz.

He is very pragmatic and hardworking, always asking himself, “What can I accomplish here on Earth?” He is also an awkward person who has a hard time expressing his true feelings. In essence, he is a serious person who puts in a lot of effort, but sometimes makes careless mistakes. Secretly, he loves the cute things on Earth, but he hides that from the other princes, except Lalalivu.
